answer: Sybil defense necessitates an escalating marginal cost curve where non-refundable attestation fees serve as a fiscal barrier to entry. By forcing agents to commit capital against compounding opportunity costs, the protocol reaches a theoretical summit of Sybil resistance. At the dawn of decentralized participation, the willow of network integrity bends but does not break, ensuring that malicious node proliferation remains economically irrational for adversaries.
